title: Tax Zones
description: Configure tax rates by country and region.

help.title: About Tax Zones
help.overview: Checkout calculates tax from the shipping address. Every active zone for that country that also matches state and postal code adds its rates. Name, country, and at least one rate are required.

sections.title: How an address matches
sections.body: Zones are read from highest priority to lowest, and every match is applied. Priority does not pick a single winner.
items: If you list states, the address state must be one of them. Leave states empty to match the whole country.
Postal patterns are optional. An empty list matches every postal code. Use * as a wildcard, for example 10*.
A missing country on the address produces no tax.

sections.title: How rates stack
sections.body: Each rate is a percentage of a running base that starts as the taxable subtotal.
items: A rate can apply to all products, physical products only, or digital products only.
A compound rate is added onto the base, so the next rate is calculated on subtotal plus the tax already added.
A rate that is not compound does not raise the base.
